title: Brenda H NDE 22491
content: I fell and the next thing I knew, I was in bed in a hospital room. But I was also up near the ceiling, looking down at myself in the bed. My Mom and my Grandma were at my Grandma's house, and I saw them there, crying. Next thing I saw was the Universe. Then I saw the light. It kept asking me to come to it. I saw my relatives in line. They told me to go to the light, too. I finally got to the light, and a voice told me that I have to go back - that they are not ready for me yet - because I still have some things to do. The next thing I remember is being back in my body.

elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw some relatives. They said to go to the light.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a bright light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I don't know.
